$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Use ./klint.schema.json for local validation or https://klint.dev/schema.json for the published schema.

root.description: Root directory used to resolve include paths and report relative file names. Defaults to the directory containing klint.config.json.

include.description: Glob patterns selecting which TypeScript files to lint. Prefix with ! to exclude. Defaults to ["."] which lints all .ts files under root. Example: ["src", "klint", "!**/node_modules/**"]

rules.description: Built-in rules to enforce. Each entry is either a rule name string or a scoped object restricting the rule to a file subset. Run `klint --help` for the full rule list.

rule.description: Name of the built-in or custom rule to apply.

include.description: Glob patterns scoping this rule to a subset of files. Prefix with ! to exclude. Example: ["src/hooks/**", "!src/hooks/scripts/**"]

anyOf.description: A rule entry that applies a named rule only to files matching the given include patterns.

items.description: Either a rule name (string) or an object scoping a named rule to specific files.

customRules.description: Names of custom rules exported from klint.rules.ts (or the file passed via --rules). Custom rules run after built-in rules.

description: klint configuration. Lives at klint.config.json next to biome.json and knip.json.
